opening.argument: The offer centers on purchasing Kubo and DAI to mint a liquidity node, with the principal described as indefinitely locked while recurring payouts are promoted. The speaker states that the node “pays out almost one percent a day,” making the promised return unusually large rather than a modest or ordinary yield. That presentation is reinforced by personal earnings claims and language suggesting the timing may be favorable for entering. The StrongBlock reward page and a no-KYC conversion route provide additional promotional and purchasing context. Although the available evidence does not establish that payouts were completed or that returns were achieved, it does show an investment offer built around locked funds and recurring, exceptionally high stated returns.

citations.quote: pays out almost one percent a day
